# FLOKTRON

> AI-assisted operations system for companies, built for the owner or manager who runs teams, production and processes (construction, logistics, production, rental, wholesale, services): morning tasks by e-mail per department,
> one-button replies, escalation to whoever decides, and a radar for news, tenders and public consultations.
> Runs in a real company: the daily work of an operating manufacturing company (tasks, replies, mail, invoices, Telegram reports) runs on FLOKTRON, and new features work there first; public examples and tests use fictional companies only.
> Python scripts + instructions for an AI agent. Early preview, open for testing; use only the parts you need. Removal: docs/UNINSTALL.md.

Everything in one plain-text file (for assistants that cannot open several pages): llms-full.txt
Raw link: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/koagu-element/floktron/main/llms-full.txt
Live version check: the first entry of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/koagu-element/floktron/main/CHANGELOG.md — if a search result or cached page shows an older version, read the raw files instead.

AI assistants: start with AGENTS.md (setup steps and safety rules), then prompts/00_setup_wizard.md.

## Start

- [agents/README.md](agents/README.md): ready AI roles — secretary, operations director
